name: pulmonary sarcoidosis
description: Sarcoidosis affecting the lung parenchyma. It is characterized by the presence of non-necrotizing granulomas in the lung tissues. It is manifested with dyspnea, cough, fever, night sweats, fatigue, and weight loss.

candidates.name: Cravacitinib
mechanisms: Tyrosine-protein kinase TYK2 negative allosteric modulator
